meta.purpose: Target-aware, non-mutating machine readiness, dependency-installation planning and authority-scoped installation validation.

profile.description: Install the human CLI, live Watchdog and AI-facing MCP runtime together; target language evidence controls only language-toolchain requirements.

selection.public_target_repository: PUBLIC_DISTRIBUTION_MANIFEST.json is present at the installation root.
selection.private_maintainer: No public distribution manifest is present at the canonical source root.

public_target_repository.purpose: Validate only installation and target-repository surfaces shipped in the public projection.
public_target_repository.claim_boundary: A public installation PASS does not validate private projection machinery, SAGE self-release governance or the target repository's engineering verdict.

private_maintainer.purpose: Validate public installation surfaces plus private projection and SAGE release-maintainer controls.

claim_boundary: The plan observes one machine and one target snapshot. It may authorize declared SAGE-local package installation, but it never installs system runtimes, mutates the target repository, proves full analysis correctness or replaces clean-machine installation proof.
